title: Heavy storms drop 81.6mm on Jurong Island
detail: MSS said heavy thunderstorms over southern and western Singapore on 7 Jan produced the month's highest daily rainfall to mid-January, 81.6mm at Jurong Island; the first half of January was otherwise mostly dry.

title: Tampines flat fire forces evacuation of about 100 residents
detail: SCDF said a bedroom fire in a 15th-floor unit at Block 29 Tampines Street 86, reported at 21:05, was put out with two water jets; about 100 residents were evacuated and one firefighter was hospitalised for heat exhaustion.

title: ISA Restriction Order on self-radicalised 14-year-old
detail: ISD said a 14-year-old Secondary Three student, self-radicalised by ISIS propaganda online, was issued a Restriction Order in Nov 2025; he had pledged allegiance to ISIS and drafted mock attack plans but made no concrete preparations. ISD also reported one detainee released and three ROs lapsed.

title: 217 scammers and money mules investigated
detail: SPF said a 16-29 Jan islandwide operation investigated 217 people aged 16-83 linked to over 700 scam cases with losses of more than S$7.67 million.

title: Exercise SG Ready 2026 simulates prolonged power and digital outages
detail: MINDEF said about 1,000 organisations would take part from 1 to 15 February in a national exercise simulating an energy-security crisis with prolonged power outages and degraded connectivity; the Public Warning System sounded on 1 February at 15:00.

title: PUB flash-flood risk warning in Jurong/Boon Lay
detail: PUB warned at 15:32 of flash-flood risk along Jalan Boon Lay (International Rd to Enterprise Rd) and at Yuan Ching Rd/Yung Kuang Rd, advising the public to avoid the area for an hour amid heavy rain.

title: CNB islandwide operation: 99 arrested
detail: CNB said a 2-6 Feb islandwide operation covering Ang Mo Kio, Choa Chu Kang, Jurong, Marine Parade, Marsiling and Sembawang led to 99 arrests and seizures worth over S$38,000, including cannabis, heroin, Ice and etomidate vape pods.

title: CNB 2025 drug report: new abusers up 17%
detail: CNB reported 3,208 drug abusers arrested in 2025 (up 1%), with new abusers up 17% to 1,165, half under 30, and the youngest arrested aged 12; drugs seized were valued at about S$21.95 million.

title: Flash flood on Jurong Town Hall Road
detail: PUB reported a flash flood on Jurong Town Hall Road between Jurong East St 11 and 12 at about 17:55 on the second day of Chinese New Year, subsiding by about 6.16:00; MSS had warned of heavy thundery showers over the south, west and central areas.
attribution: PUB and MSS alerts via AsiaOne

title: S$350m more seized in Prince Group laundering probe
detail: SPF said three Singaporeans were arrested (Nov 2025-Jan 2026) for suspected money laundering linked to Prince Holding Group, founded by sanctioned tycoon Chen Zhi, and that about S$350 million in properties, vehicles, cash, accounts and luxury goods were newly seized or prohibited, taking the total to over S$500 million.

title: 12 Protection from Scams Act restriction orders issued
detail: MHA said in a written parliamentary reply that police had issued 12 restriction orders on at-risk scam victims' bank accounts as of 15 Feb 2026, with 9 still in effect.

title: Fund manager directors arrested; S$160m seized
detail: SPF and MAS said two directors of a licensed fund management company were arrested on suspicion of money laundering and more than S$160 million seized, after STRO intelligence; MAS cited serious AML control failings.

title: Three sea robberies on bulk carriers in Phillip Channel
detail: ReCAAP ISC reported three robberies on bulk carriers in the eastbound lane of the Phillip Channel TSS on 18-19 March, within 0.7-1.7 nm of each other; one crew member was injured and engine spares were stolen from one ship. It said all 10 incidents in the Straits since January were in the Singapore Strait.

title: Nominee director and company secretary charged over shell firms
detail: SPF said a 35-year-old resident director and a 36-year-old corporate service provider would be charged after two Singapore shell companies received about US$1.08 million and EUR 44,800 in overseas scam proceeds in 2023.

title: Warm dry spell forecast with 35-36C highs and haze risk
detail: NEA/MSS forecast daily highs of 35-36C in late March under dry northeast monsoon conditions and warned hotspots in Central Sumatra and Johor could raise haze risk; PSI was 45-57 on 20 March.

title: 35.4C recorded at Sembawang
detail: MSS said the second half of March was dry with sparse rain, with the highest temperature of 35.4C at Sembawang on 30 March; it forecast inter-monsoon thundery showers from early April.

title: Welder dies in confined pipe at Tuas shipyard
detail: MOM said a 24-year-old welder was found unconscious inside a 28-inch pipe on a vessel module at a Tuas South Boulevard shipyard and pronounced dead; it reminded employers of confined-space atmospheric testing and permit-to-work rules.

title: Singaporean deported from Cambodia to face scam charges
detail: SPF said a 29-year-old Singaporean was arrested on deportation from Cambodia for allegedly giving a scam syndicate access to bank accounts in 2021-2022.

title: Signalling fault halts all 27 Thomson-East Coast Line stations
detail: SMRT said a signalling fault after overnight tests stopped trains across the whole TEL from 08:14, with delays from 06:55; service fully resumed at 10:48 and free and bridging buses were deployed.
place: Thomson-East Coast Line (Woodlands North to Bayshore)

title: Member of Phnom Penh scam compound group repatriated
detail: SPF said a 30-year-old Singaporean arrested by Cambodian police was repatriated on 4 May over links to a Phnom Penh-based group running government-official impersonation scams tied to at least 535 cases and about S$53 million in losses; Interpol Red Notices were issued for two more suspects.

title: Worker killed by falling concrete slab at Cross Island Line site
detail: A 23-year-old banksman was struck and killed by a concrete slab during excavation at the Turf City MRT station worksite on Turf Club Road; MOM issued a stop-work order to the contractor joint venture and opened a joint investigation with police.
place: Turf City MRT station worksite, Turf Club Road

title: NEA: peak dengue season begins
detail: NEA said over 600 dengue cases were reported as of 15 May 2026, about 66% fewer than a year earlier, and urged vigilance as the May-October peak season began; Project Wolbachia is to cover about half of households by end-2026.

title: Operation FRONTIER+ III: 130+ arrests in Singapore
detail: SPF said the 10-territory Operation FRONTIER+ III (10 Mar-7 May) led to over 130 arrests in Singapore, 2,315 bank accounts frozen and S$34.9 million seized; regionally 3,018 were arrested over fraud totalling about US$752 million.
attribution: SPF figures via The Online Citizen

title: 295 scammers and money mules investigated
detail: SPF said a 7-20 May operation investigated 295 people aged 15-76 linked to over 751 scam cases with losses over S$5 million.

title: Southwest Monsoon onset; warm nights forecast
detail: MSS said the Southwest Monsoon was setting in during early June, with Sumatra squalls possible on several pre-dawn mornings, highs of 33-35C, nights often above 28C and below-average rain in the first half of June.

title: Supply boat sinks after collision off Pasir Panjang; 3 dead
detail: MPA said a supply boat collided with a landing craft off Pasir Panjang Terminal at about 09:30 and sank; the PCG recovered three bodies believed to be its crew. Port operations were not disrupted.
agency: Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore

title: Dengue cases hit 2026 weekly high of 119
detail: NEA reported 119 dengue cases in the week to 13 June, up 39 from the week before and the highest weekly count of 2026, with 12 active clusters including four red-alert clusters.

title: First transnational etomidate vape pod syndicate busted
detail: HSA said it arrested four Singaporean men in raids on flats in Teck Whye and Tampines, seizing 1,111 etomidate vape pods (street value over S$83,000) and cash; it linked the group to a May importation case at Woodlands Checkpoint involving pods worth over S$800,000.

title: ISA orders on two Singaporeans radicalised by pro-Hamas narratives
detail: ISD said a 30-year-old was detained under the ISA after seeking to join Hamas and indicating willingness to conduct attacks if instructed, and a 19-year-old was issued a Restriction Order for online posts inciting violence under composite violent extremist beliefs.

title: Singapore-flagged Ever Lovely hit by projectile in Hormuz
detail: MPA said the Singapore-registered container ship Ever Lovely sustained minor bridge damage from an unknown projectile while transiting the Strait of Hormuz; all 21 crew were safe. MPA called the strike unprovoked and a breach of international law.
agency: Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore

title: MOT on recourse for Hormuz projectile strike
detail: The Transport Ministry said the Ever Lovely's managers may pursue war-risk or marine insurance claims and reiterated Singapore's position on the right of transit passage under UNCLOS.

title: Singapore Strait sea robberies down 74% in H1
detail: ReCAAP ISC counted 21 robbery incidents in the Singapore Strait in H1 2026 versus 80 a year earlier; its executive director credited industry preventive measures and law-enforcement responses by littoral states.

title: Three youths aged 14-19 detained under ISA over attack plans
detail: ISD said three self-radicalised male youths (14, 15 and 19) were detained between April and June 2026 after making concrete preparations for attacks, including a planned school stabbing and pressure-cooker bombs; ISD said the 14-year-old is the youngest person ever detained under the ISA.

title: Over 5kg of cannabis seized in three raids
detail: CNB said raids at Ang Mo Kio Ave 4, Pasir Ris St 11 and Jalan Bukit Ho Swee netted three Singaporean men and about 5.5kg of cannabis plus Ice, ketamine and LSD, worth over S$142,000.
place: Ang Mo Kio, Pasir Ris, Bukit Ho Swee

title: Clementi HDB flat fire kills one, injures two firefighters
detail: SCDF said a fire in an 8th-floor unit at Block 309 Clementi Avenue 4 around 23:10 left one occupant dead in hospital and two firefighters with burns; about 40 residents were evacuated. Cause under investigation.

title: Scams (Countermeasures) Bill tabled
detail: MHA tabled a bill letting police disable accounts, restrict suspected mules' access to banking, telco and Singpass services for up to 3 years, criminalise supplying online accounts, and raise platform penalties to S$10 million per breach; tech outlets reported it passed on 9 Sept.

title: 2,428 caught vaping in Q2; nine charged over etomidate
detail: HSA and MOH said 2,428 people were caught for vape possession or use from April to June 2026 (457 involving etomidate pods), over 3,900 vaporisers were seized at checkpoints and nine people were charged for importing or supplying etomidate vapes.

title: 270 scammers and money mules investigated
detail: SPF said a 30 Jul-12 Aug operation by Cyber Command and all seven land divisions investigated 270 people aged 15-80 linked to more than 660 scam cases with losses of about S$5.4 million.

title: H1 scam cases fall 17.9%; losses S$410.6m
detail: SPF reported 18,391 scam and cybercrime cases in H1 2026 (down from 22,397) with losses of S$410.6 million (from S$500.2 million); investment scams caused the largest losses and the Anti-Scam Centre recovered over S$97.7 million.
attribution: SPF mid-year brief via Malay Mail

title: 24-hr PSI enters Unhealthy range for first time since 2023
detail: NEA said the 24-hr PSI in the central region entered the Unhealthy range (above 100) at 07:00 on 4 Sept, the first time since Oct 2023, and activated haze measures including air purifiers in schools and healthcare facilities and daily haze advisories.

title: RSN-PLA Navy Exercise Maritime Cooperation 2026
detail: MINDEF said frigate RSS Steadfast joined the PLA Navy's PLANS Dali for the fifth Exercise Maritime Cooperation off Zhanjiang, China, 5-9 Sept, including gunnery, manoeuvring and SAR drills.

title: Auctions of assets forfeited in S$3b laundering case begin
detail: Deloitte, appointed by SPF, said public auctions of over 80 properties and 1,000+ luxury items forfeited in the 2023 S$3 billion money-laundering case would run from 7 Sept 2026 into mid-2027.

title: Haze eases to Moderate; smoke plumes persist
detail: MSS said 24-hr PSI was 74-97 (Moderate) at 17:00 on 9 Sept, with smoke plumes still detected from fires in southern and central Sumatra and Kalimantan, and forecast High Moderate to Low Unhealthy levels.

title: ISD threat assessment: self-radicalised youth surge
detail: ISD's 2026 Terrorism Threat Assessment said eight people were dealt with under the ISA since July 2025, six of them under 21, and that youth cases rose from 4 (2017-2021) to 15 since 2022; it also flagged first cases of composite violent extremism.

title: MSS forecasts haze to worsen to mid-Unhealthy
detail: MSS said 24-hr PSI was 88-117 at 17:00 on 14 Sept as east-southeasterly winds carried smoke from fires in Kalimantan and southern Sumatra, and forecast the 24-hr PSI in the High Moderate to Mid Unhealthy range.

title: Bulk carrier collides with Chinese fishing vessel in Singapore Strait
detail: MPA said Panama-registered bulker First Margaux collided with a China-registered fishing vessel, which took on water but stayed afloat and was towed to Raffles Reserved Anchorage; no injuries, pollution or traffic impact reported.
agency: Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore

title: CNB islandwide operation: 82 arrested
detail: CNB said a 14-18 Sept operation in Ang Mo Kio, Macpherson, Geylang and Lavender led to 82 arrests and drugs worth over S$46,700, including about 1.15kg of cannabis.
